blocks.text: Capacitors are used in various household appliances such as electric fans, water drawing motors, washing machines refrigerators, flashguns, computer keyboards, touchscreens etc. We will describe here a few of them with some detail.

blocks.alt: Wiring of a fan motor. Supply terminals N and L. From the common point on N, the running coil (an outer ring of coils) goes round to L; the starting coil (an inner ring of coils) goes from the common point through a capacitor to L. Labels: Common, Capacitor, Starting Coil, Running Coil.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.17: Electric fan: wiring of the starting and running coils with the capacitor (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 16.17; its photographs are not reproduced).
